# Tes

> > Tes provides comprehensive education technology solutions including school management systems, payroll services, and learning pathway tools for K-12 schools and educators.

Tes offers a suite of integrated education software products including Class Charts for behavior management, EduPay for school payroll, Learning Pathways for curriculum planning, and additional tools like School Robins, Provision Map, and Room Booking. The platform serves schools, teachers, and administrators with end-to-end solutions for classroom management, staff administration, and student learning.

## Key Topics

- Class Charts
- EduPay
- Learning Pathways
- School Robins
- Provision Map
- Teach Starter
- School management software
- Education payroll systems
- Behavior management
- Learning plans and templates
- Staff Management
- Parents' Meetings
- Room Booking
- Knowledge base and support
- Education technology
